injuryBanner.message: Rehab session for your shoulder injury

items.name: Pendulum (Codman) exercise
items.note: Lean forward, support the good arm on a table. Let the injured arm hang. Swing it gently in small circles using body weight only.
items.rationale: Gentle traction distraction of the glenohumeral joint — reduces pain and early stiffness without active muscle contraction.

items.name: Scapular setting
items.note: Sit or stand tall. Gently draw the shoulder blades down and back — as if putting them into your back pockets. Hold 5s.
items.rationale: Activates the lower trapezius and serratus anterior to establish correct scapular position before loading.
